description: Check the status of any queued background work — report generation, wallet sync, rule application, or a transaction change — using the requestId returned when it was queued. Works for every request kind; there is no separate report-status tool.

requestId.description: Request ID returned by the call that queued the work (e.g. incremental_sync, full_resync, request_report_export)

transactionId.description: Optional transaction ID that caused the async request, for agent context

name: get_request_status
title: Get Request Status
